heading: Reminder: Compare Before Renewing Insurance
body: Health and term insurance premiums vary significantly across insurers for the same cover amount and age. Before auto-renewing, spend 10 minutes comparing at least 3 quotes — insurers rarely reward long-term loyalty with the best rate.

heading: Credit Card Cashback: Read the Fine Print
body: 'Up to 5% cashback' offers usually apply only to specific categories, often with a monthly cap (e.g. max ₹500 cashback). Check the category list and cap before assuming a card's headline rate applies to your actual spending pattern.

heading: Annual Subscription Audit Reminder
body: The average household loses track of at least one recurring subscription they no longer use. Pull up your last 2 bank/card statements this week and cancel anything you can't remember actively using in the last 3 months.

heading: Festive Season Spending Check
body: Festive discounts are real, but 'limited time' urgency is a classic trigger for unplanned spending. Before buying something only because it's discounted, apply the 7-day wait rule from our earlier tip — if you still want it next week, it's a real want, not urgency-driven.

heading: No-Cost EMI: Check the Real Price First
body: Before taking a 'no-cost EMI' offer, check the straight cash price for the same product elsewhere. The EMI cost is frequently absorbed into a higher sticker price rather than genuinely waived — a quick price comparison takes 2 minutes and can save you real money.

heading: Checking Your Loan Prepayment Options
body: Many home and personal loans allow partial prepayment without penalty once you're past a certain tenure, but this isn't always advertised proactively by the lender. A quick call to check your prepayment terms could cut real interest cost off your loan.

heading: Year-End Tax-Saving Deadline Reminder
body: 80C and other tax-saving investment deadlines (typically March 31 for the Indian financial year) sneak up every year. Check your tax-saving investments now rather than in a rush during the last week of March, when decisions tend to be worse.

heading: Comparing Fixed Deposit Rates
body: FD rates can vary by 0.5-1% between banks and NBFCs for the same tenure — on a large deposit over several years, that gap adds up to real money. Always check at least 2-3 options before locking in a long-tenure FD.
